shared_elements: shallow relief carving on a flat stone surface
anthropomorphic figure with visible head and limbs
rectangular object with incised hatching (possible handled object)
horizontal band of repeated linear/zigzag pattern
justification: Both are pale stone slabs bearing schematic figural relief that includes a rectangular, hatched object resembling a handled item and small creature forms set against a plain ground, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is dominated by a single, nearly three-dimensional standing figure emerging from the block with flanking low-relief shapes, while B is organised into flat, strictly horizontal registers of repeated arched motifs and a banded pattern above a row of animals — different relief depth, compositional logic and degree of modelling.
